استسهلا (form X)

# اُسْتُسْهِلَا (ustushilā) /us.tus.hi.laː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَسْهَلَ (istashala)
# اِسْتَسْهِلَا (istashilā) /is.tas.hi.laː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَسْهَلَ (istashala)
